project: 115 kV Substation SCADA and Solar Monitoring
status: Educational design specification; network implementation follows in Phase 4
parameter_basis: All equipment parameters below are illustrative assumptions, not utility or manufacturer data.

breaker.name: CB1
breaker.delay_basis: Illustrative simulation delay, not a real breaker specification

main_transformer.name: T1
main_transformer.tap_changer: Fixed nominal ratio in the first version

load.name: LOAD1
load.model: Constant P and Q while supplied
load.test_range_note: The upper demand range intentionally permits overload scenarios above the 20 MVA transformer rating

solar.name: PV1
solar.model: Grid-following static P/Q injection with Python operating logic
solar.pq_limit_policy: Active-power priority; clamp reactive output to the remaining apparent-power capability
solar.night_policy: No active or reactive output in the initial version
solar.restart_policy: After grid restoration, start only when the bus is energized and permissives are satisfied
solar.temperature_model: Optional illustrative first-order thermal state in Python, not computed by power flow

protection.short_circuit_method: Separate IEC 60909 calculation on a copy of the network
protection.initial_fault_contributions: External grid only; PV contribution excluded from the initial fault study
protection.settings_basis: Illustrative logic for a training demonstration; no relay coordination or protection-grade timing claim

alarm_examples.basis: Training thresholds, not utility settings; voltage alarms require valid, energized-bus data

modbus.reserved_addresses: Allocated reserved points read as zero and are not used as measurements or commands
modbus.area_model: Separate holding-register and discrete-input blocks in the full server
modbus.signed_encoding: Signed int16 values use two complement encoding and Ignition HR addressing; unsigned values use HRUS
modbus.overflow_policy: Flag invalid data; do not silently wrap analog measurements

command_protocol.commit_order: Write code and wait for successful completion, then write a new sequence number; do not submit a second command while one is pending
command_protocol.processing: Process each new sequence once; position feedback determines completion

conventions.voltage: Nominal voltage and voltage telemetry are line-to-line RMS
conventions.current: CB1 current is the main transformer high-voltage winding RMS current; line charging current upstream may remain when CB1 is open
conventions.grid_p: Positive means import into our modeled network; negative means export to the external grid
conventions.grid_q: Positive means reactive import from the grid; negative means reactive export
conventions.solar_q: Positive means reactive injection by PV1 into the AC network; negative means absorption
conventions.load_q: Positive means reactive demand; negative means capacitive injection
